content: official-stockfish/nnue-pytorch docs/nnue.md is the definitive NNUE reference (theory, incremental accumulator, quantization, training). Feature transformer weights quantized int16, accumulator int16; linear-layer weights int8 (range clamped ~ activation 0..1). Trainer clamps params to quantization range each optimizer step to avoid divergence. Layers: Linear + ClippedReLU(clamp 0,1). Reference arch for this project: plain (768->N)x2->1.
